title: 2.7.13: repeated-task evaluation
description: Validate the instruction policy over repeated experiments on accepted tasks before it becomes a default: cost per accepted task, quality, retries and controller overhead, measured together.

title: A site that carries the brand
description: The landing as the front door, the documentation, the catalogue of models and prices, the roadmap and the changelog as pages of one site, and a brand page, all in the design system the project already chose and each with a way to GitHub.

title: Trazum speaks first
description: The status line, the watcher and the spend guard exist and are off until somebody wires each by hand. Next: one command that turns them on and off, a watcher that reads the agents' sessions directly and says so on the screen, a weekly summary that arrives on its own, a plan that can open the pull request, and a terminal that carries the brand.

title: 3.0.0: the release allowed to break
description: A major is the only release that may remove something. This one removes `tier` from a model in the pricing catalogue, deprecated since 1.8.0 in favour of `capability`, and nothing its changelog entry does not list.

title: The price anyone can check
description: Every comparable tool prices from the same community file and calls the figure an estimate, and a model it cannot price counts as zero. Next: the catalogue published as an open dataset with the provider's page and the date read behind every row, and a pull request comment that says what a change does to a prompt's monthly cost against the base branch, each figure with its dated price.

title: The bill where a team already looks
description: The bill is printed, saved or gated. Next: the same measured figures as metrics for the dashboards a team already runs, and what was spent in a repository while a branch was written, said as a time window and never as the cost of the change.

title: A repository a stranger can contribute to
description: What a visitor and a contributor need that is not the product: a roadmap that opens with what comes next, a wiki that publishes itself, documents that agree with each other, and Discussions with a form for each kind of question.

title: Tests that would notice a wrong price
description: Line coverage says the code that prices a call runs under test. Mutation testing says whether a test would notice it pricing a call wrongly, and today it reaches six files of the core and, in two more, the functions that choose a rate and multiply by it. Next: the catalogue's own numbers, where a sample found published prices that no test would notice changing.

title: Every agent's sessions
description: The bill reads what each coding agent already keeps on disk. Next: OpenCode's SQLite sessions, and a reader for Cursor, GitHub Copilot CLI, Cline and Amp as soon as somebody supplies one real session of each.

title: Every provider, counted and priced exactly
description: The estimator's error measured against each provider's own counter, a tokenizer package where the error is large, retired models marked on the provider's own evidence, and the gateway in front of the providers it does not front yet.

title: Seven dictionaries, each read by a speaker
description: Five of the seven trimming dictionaries were never read by somebody who reads the language. Each needs a reviewer; docs/language-maintainer.md says what the role is.

title: Where people meet Trazum
description: The editor extension on the VS Code Marketplace, the playground as a Hugging Face Space, the hosted web app measured for how fast it loads, off unless its operator asks, a page that says what Trazum Pro is and that it is not open yet, and a download page at /download for the files each release carries.

title: The optional model pass
description: Choose and test a model-side optimiser candidate, behind the opt-in layer, with the deterministic core unchanged.
